speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
text: asked	the Minister for Health what are the infrastructure investments that have been implemented or are being implemented to support our social and economic development in the face of an ageing population.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Ministerial Committee on Ageing oversees and coordinates these efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Singaporeans can access heavily-funded CET programmes to upskill and reskill throughout their lifetime.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: There are also professional conversion programmes to support mid-career switches for PMETs.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Many new initiatives have been introduced under SkillsFuture, such as skills-based modular courses.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: In addition, workplace health programmes have been put in place to keep mature workers healthy.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Second, we are investing in infrastructure and programmes to cater to the social needs of seniors.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Third, we have been expanding our health and aged care infrastructure as outlined in Healthcare 2020.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Fourth, we are systematically refreshing our housing estates, transport system and parks to make our city senior-friendly.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: All new public housing estates already have barrier-free designs.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We have enhanced road safety for seniors and improved access to public transport.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We are experimenting with "therapeutic gardens" and we welcome seniors to our parks to enjoy the sunshine, the greenery and nature, and to stay healthy and active.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Government will continue to plan ahead to ensure that infrastructure developments keep up with the needs of an ageing population.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: But preparing for the future involves not just infrastructure investments.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We also need all citizens to work together to create inclusive workplaces and community to support our seniors.
